title: The Netherlands
description: Analogue photographs from the Netherlands by Bart Mulder: dunes, a foggy river and frost in a winter landscape, all shot on film.

images.alt: Two vending machines next to a brick wall and a bench inside a train station or similar setting with large windows in the background.
Beachside houses on sandy dunes with the ocean in the background under a partly cloudy sky during sunset.
A calm river flowing through a forest with bare and some leafy trees, fog on the water, and hills in the distance under a clear sky.
A broken white plastic chair tilted on sandy ground outside a white building with a window, under a clear blue sky with a few clouds.

A white personal watercraft, or jet ski, with a beige seat, parked on green grass near a calm body of water. Tall trees with green foliage are on either side, and a foggy atmosphere obscures boats and structures in the background.
A historic brick building next to a river with a small dock and stairs leading down to the water, with trees in the background on a foggy morning.
Leafless trees in a winter landscape with frost on the ground and rocks, illuminated by warm sunlight.
